title: 병원 문진표 읽기: 어디가, 언제부터 아파요?
objective: You can read a Korean clinic intake form (문진표) and find symptoms, medicines, allergies and past surgery.
summary: Learn to read a Korean clinic intake form.
note: The clinic name and patient details in this worksheet are made up for practice.

task.title: Read and fill in the form
task.line: Use the form words and the reading tips from page 1 to answer each question.

items.text: Write the year, month and day you were born.
Check or write what is wrong with your body.
Write any medicine you take these days.
items.example: 지금 먹는 약이 있어요? 네, 두통약을 먹어요.

items.text: Write any food or medicine that is bad for your body.
Tell the doctor about any operation you had before.
Women answer this before they get medicine or an X-ray.
Check one of the two boxes for each question.

sections.heading: Read a filled-in form
paragraphs: This is a form for a patient at a clinic for internal medicine (내과). ■ means checked.
5. 수술을 받은 적이 있습니까?  □없음  ■있음 (2020년, 무릎 수술)

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Look for the checked box (■ or ✔). That is the answer. If someone checked 있음, read the words in ( ) next to it. They tell you what: which medicine, which allergy, what surgery.
(여성만) means 'women only'. Men can skip that question. 기타 means 'other'. Write your own answer in the ( ).

exercises: Read the form and answer in English: 성명: 이수아 | 증상: ■콧물 ■목 아픔 □열 | 언제부터: 어제 아침부터 | 약 알레르기: □없음 ■있음 (페니실린) — ① What are her symptoms? ② When did they start? ③ What is she allergic to?
Which box do you check, 있음 or 없음? ① 저는 요즘 약을 안 먹어요. → 복용 중인 약 ② 새우를 먹으면 몸이 가려워요. → 알레르기 ③ 10년 전에 팔 수술을 받았어요. → 수술
Fill in the blank with a word from page 1: ① 일주일 전____ 허리가 아파요. ② 저는 우유 ________가 있어요. 우유를 마시면 배가 아파요.
Read the form line and write O (true) or X (false): '(여성만) 임신 중입니까? ■아니요 □예' ① Only women answer this question. ② The patient is pregnant. ③ The patient checked 아니요.
Answer in Korean: The nurse asks, "언제부터 아팠어요?" You started feeling sick two days ago.
answers: ① a runny nose and a sore throat (no fever) ② yesterday morning ③ penicillin
① 없음 ② 있음 ③ 있음
① O ② X ③ O
이틀 전부터요. (2일 전부터요. / 이틀 전부터 아팠어요.)
